For teachers and tutors

About Do What It Says

A game for following short spoken instructions. Classroom rounds use everyday things: "Tap the book.", "Open the door.", "Tap the cup." Device rounds use phone instructions: "Turn the sound off.", "Charge the battery.", "Take a photo." Every answer has a picture.

How to play

  1. Listen to the instruction.
  2. Look at the pictures.
  3. Tap what it says.

Play it as a class

Choose Do What It Says in the Teacher Game, then do the same instructions for real in the room.
